1.title: Park cars face to face off
1.say: Drive fronts together close without touching. Turn both keys off and set brakes.
placements: good working car front → facing dead car front, bumpers close without touching, in the video: red and black cars nose to nose in lot
ignition key in each car → turned to off with engine silent, in the video: dash dark before start
watch_for: if the bumpers touch, roll back a little so cables reach without strain.
if either dash still lights, the key is not fully off.
1.check_yourself: It should look like two fronts facing with a small gap.
1.safety: Keep everyone clear while you roll the cars.

2.title: Open hoods find both batteries
2.say: Pull the hood release and lift both hoods. Look for the boxy battery with two posts.
placements: hood on each car → lifted up and held open over front engine area, in the video: red hood held up and black hood held by wooden stick
battery in each engine area → big boxy block with plus post marked plus and minus post marked minus, in the video: black box at front corner near headlight
watch_for: if you see no battery, look under a plastic lid near the sides.
if the hood will not stay up, hold it while you look.
2.check_yourself: It should look like both hoods up with batteries seen.
2.safety: Hold the hood up till the stick catches so it cannot fall.

3.title: Clip red to the plus post
3.say: Clip one red clamp onto the dead plus post. Clip other red clamp onto the good plus post.
placements: first red clamp → onto plus post of dead battery usually marked plus or under red cover, in the video: on red car battery front right post
second red clamp → onto plus post of good battery usually marked plus or under red cover, in the video: on black car battery front post
watch_for: if a red clamp wiggles, squeeze it tighter onto the plus post only.
if the two red clamps can touch, move cables apart so they stay separate.
3.check_yourself: It should look like two red clamps gripping both plus posts.
3.safety: Keep free clamps apart so they never touch each other.

4.title: Clip black to minus and metal
4.say: Clip one black clamp onto the good minus post. Clip other black clamp onto bare dead car metal.
placements: black clamp from cable → onto minus post of good battery usually marked minus, in the video: on black car battery
second black clamp → onto bare shiny engine metal on dead car away from battery, in the video: on bolt above headlight on black car engine edge
watch_for: if the last black clamp is on the dead minus post, move it to bare metal.
if the clamp sits on paint or plastic, move to shiny bare metal for grip.
4.check_yourself: It should look like one black on minus and one on metal.
4.safety: Keep the last clamp off the dead minus post to avoid sparks.

5.title: Start good car to charge
5.say: Turn the good car key to start the engine. Let it run a few minutes to charge.
placements: key in good car → turned to start spot right of wheel until engine runs, in the video: hand turning key with red dash lights on tan dash
watch_for: if the engine dies right away, wait longer before trying the dead car.
if cables lie on belts or fans, move them clear so they cannot catch.
5.check_yourself: It should look like dash lights on with engine running.
5.safety: Keep hands and clothes clear of spinning belts and fan.

6.title: Start dead car remove cables
6.say: Turn the dead car key to start the engine. Unclip all four clamps without letting them touch. Let the revived car run a few minutes.
placements: key in dead car → turned to start spot until engine runs on its own, in the video: hand turning key in second car
all four clamps → lifted off posts and metal and held apart clear of engine, removal order bare metal first then good minus then good plus then dead plus, in the video: bays empty with cables clear
watch_for: if the dead car will not start, wait and let the good car charge longer.
if clamps touch each other while removing, keep them apart in the air.
6.check_yourself: It should look like both engines running with no cables.
6.safety: Keep clamps apart while lifting them off so they cannot spark.
